consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: OEM service bulletin affecting ELEC-CLASS-A

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on TX-9001 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-9001 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 5 December 2025 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
